newsitem.title: GERMANY: German air cargo imports up 5.1pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: German air cargo imports up 5.1pct in 1996.

text.p: Air cargo imports to Germany rose 5.1 percent to 919,382 tonnes in 1996, the German airports association (ADV) said.
The main gateway, Frankfurt airport, showed a 1.8 percent rise to 613,635 tonnes last year, an ADV traffic report said.
Imports at Cologne rose 13.3 percent to 158,431 tonnes and Munich was up 24.5 percent to 38,984 tonnes.
Double-figure import air cargo growth was also recorded at Stuttgart, Nuremberg and smaller airports, the ADV said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
